follow-up time: From first trimester until after birth, and neurodevelopmental assessment at not specified time
cohort: 52 MCMA twin pregnancies and 671 MCDA twin pregnancies followed from the first trimester
finding: Monochorionic monoamniotic (MCMA) twin pregnancies are associated with decreased survival rates compared to monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) pregnancies due to increased rates of double intrauterine demise.
mod_finding: After 28 weeks, about one in eight women with MCMA twin pregnancies required an urgent delivery for fetal distress.
